_readme: The built-in avatar shot pack (module 09), ported from factory api/config/avatar-shots.json.
Read by app/vf/modules/avatars/catalog.py; one avatar gets one slot per shot.
Each shot is ONE photograph. Everything that is true of every frame —
the locked identity, the lens and light, the realism rules, the ban on
collages — lives in the AVATAR_* prompt layers (app/prompts/layers/avatar), not here.
What is here is only what makes this frame different from the others.
A shot names no other shot: the frames are drawn one request at a time,
so the model never sees the other frames.
Left and right are the viewer's: 'left three-quarter' is the left side of
the face as you look at the picture (the head turned toward the subject's own right).
`code` is the stable key, kept in avatar_photos.shot_code. SHOT_01 is the face:
it is chosen from the candidates, not drawn with the pack.
Titles shown in the app come from web/i18n/locales/*/avatars.json (shots.SHOT_xx);
the English `prompt` is what goes to the model.

shots.title: Master Frontal Portrait
shots.description: Канонический фас. С него начинается пак — этот кадр эталон для всех остальных.
shots.prompt: Canonical frontal portrait. Eye-level camera. Head and upper chest in frame. Neutral background. Relaxed neutral-positive expression with a very subtle closed-mouth smile. This frame is the canonical reference for the whole pack.

shots.title: Left Three-Quarter Face
shots.description: Ракурс 3/4 слева — базовый разворот для баннеров и превью.
shots.prompt: Head turned 35–45 degrees toward the subject's RIGHT, so the viewer sees the LEFT three-quarter of the face. Both eyes visible.

shots.title: Left Semi-Profile
shots.description: Полупрофиль слева — между 3/4 и чистым профилем.
shots.prompt: Head turned 60–70 degrees toward the subject's RIGHT, so the viewer sees the LEFT semi-profile. Not a full profile — the far eye stays partly visible.

shots.title: Waist-Up Body Reference
shots.description: Поясной кадр: пропорции корпуса и руки в кадре.
shots.prompt: Natural standing waist-up photograph. Both arms and hands visible and correctly formed.

shots.title: Full-Body Front
shots.description: Ростовой фас — рост, сложение, обувь.
shots.prompt: Full body from head to soles. Natural stance. Both hands visible. Neutral trousers and plain sneakers.

shots.title: Right Three-Quarter Face
shots.description: Ракурс 3/4 справа. Не зеркало левого — другая сторона лица.
shots.prompt: Head turned 35–45 degrees toward the subject's LEFT, so the viewer sees the RIGHT three-quarter of the face. Both eyes visible. Preserve the face's true asymmetry — this is the other side of the head, not a mirrored copy of the left three-quarter.

shots.title: Right Semi-Profile
shots.description: Полупрофиль справа.
shots.prompt: Head turned 60–70 degrees toward the subject's LEFT, so the viewer sees the RIGHT semi-profile. Not a full profile. Draw the real anatomy of this side of the face rather than a mirrored version of the other side.

shots.title: Natural Smile
shots.description: Живая улыбка в фас — самый ходовой кадр для рекламы.
shots.prompt: Frontal portrait with a genuine, natural smile. Teeth visible. The eyes and cheeks move the way they do in a real smile.

shots.title: Seated With Hands Visible
shots.description: Сидя, руки в кадре — проверка кистей и посадки.
shots.prompt: Natural seated pose. Both forearms and hands visible, resting naturally.

shots.title: Natural Standing UGC Gesture
shots.description: Стоя, разговорный жест — подача обычного пользовательского видео.
shots.prompt: Standing conversational pose. One small open-hand gesture; the other arm relaxed.

shots.title: Product In Both Hands
shots.description: Товар в двух руках — база для продуктовых постов.
shots.prompt: Holding a small generic unbranded personal-care or skincare container in both hands. Physically correct two-handed grip: the fingers wrap the object and the object has weight.

shots.title: Smartphone UGC
shots.description: Со смартфоном — обзоры, распаковки, отзывы.
shots.prompt: A generic modern smartphone in one hand. The other hand makes a small conversational gesture.

shots.title: Mug / Lifestyle
shots.description: С кружкой на домашней кухне — тёплый лайфстайл.
shots.prompt: Holding a generic ceramic mug. Believable casual home kitchen or dining environment.

shots.title: Outdoor Daylight
shots.description: На улице при мягком дневном свете.
shots.prompt: Natural outdoor portrait in soft open shade or on an overcast day. No harsh direct sunlight.

shots.title: Warm Indoor Light
shots.description: Тёплый домашний свет вечером.
shots.prompt: Natural residential interior lit by warm household light, approximately 2800–3200K. The warm light must not change the underlying skin, eye or hair colour.

shots.title: Bathroom / Skincare Ready
shots.description: Ванная, подготовка к уходу — под бьюти-контент.
shots.prompt: Believable residential bathroom. No product in frame. Simple light neutral T-shirt. Natural getting-ready pose.

shots.title: Sofa / Living Room
shots.description: На диване в гостиной.
shots.prompt: Seated naturally on a sofa in a realistic home living room. Both hands visible.

shots.title: Desk / Home Office
shots.description: За столом с ноутбуком — рабочие и экспертные посты.
shots.prompt: Seated naturally at a desk with a generic laptop. Correct hand-to-device interaction: fingers on the keys, wrists at a natural angle.

shots.title: Natural Walking Full Body
shots.description: Ростовой в шаге на улице.
shots.prompt: Outdoor full-body walking frame. Correct reciprocal gait — opposite arm and leg forward. Natural mid-stride anatomy.

shots.title: Camera Slightly Above
shots.description: Камера чуть выше глаз — привычный ракурс селфи.
shots.prompt: Camera approximately 20–35 cm above eye level, angled roughly 10–15 degrees downward. The change of angle must not change the face.

shots.title: Camera Slightly Below
shots.description: Камера чуть ниже глаз.
shots.prompt: Camera approximately 20–35 cm below eye level, angled roughly 10–15 degrees upward. Do not turn this into a heroic or hypermasculine low-angle look.

shots.title: True Left Side Profile
shots.description: Чистый профиль слева — форма носа, подбородка и черепа.
shots.prompt: A true side profile, head at approximately 90 degrees, viewer sees the LEFT side. Document the nose, lips, chin, jawline, ear, skull shape, hairline and neck clearly.

shots.title: True Right Side Profile
shots.description: Чистый профиль справа.
shots.prompt: A true side profile of the other side, head at approximately 90 degrees, viewer sees the RIGHT side. Draw this side from life rather than as a mirrored copy of the left profile — keep the real asymmetry.

shots.title: Rear Three-Quarter / Over Shoulder
shots.description: Со спины через плечо.
shots.prompt: Body mainly facing away from the camera; the head turns naturally back over the shoulder. Neck rotation stays within what a human body can do.

shots.title: Full-Body Rear
shots.description: Ростовой со спины — затылок, стрижка, силуэт.
shots.prompt: Complete rear full-body view, head facing away. Document the back of the skull, the haircut and the body silhouette.

shots.title: Frontal Speaking
shots.description: Говорит в камеру — стартовый кадр для говорящей головы.
shots.prompt: A natural mid-speech moment, frontal. Mouth moderately open, some teeth naturally visible. Not shouting, not posing.

shots.title: Speaking Left 3/4
shots.description: Говорит, 3/4 слева.
shots.prompt: A natural mid-speech frame at three-quarters, viewer sees the LEFT three-quarter. Facial and dental identity stay exactly as they are everywhere else in the pack.

shots.title: Speaking Right 3/4
shots.description: Говорит, 3/4 справа.
shots.prompt: A natural mid-speech frame at three-quarters from the other side, viewer sees the RIGHT three-quarter. Draw the real side of the face, not a mirrored one.

shots.title: Light Natural Laughter
shots.description: Лёгкий смех — эмоция без переигрывания.
shots.prompt: A genuine, restrained laugh at about 6/10 intensity. Natural teeth, cheek lift and eye compression.

shots.title: Serious / Focused
shots.description: Серьёзно и сосредоточенно.
shots.prompt: Calm, focused expression. No smile. About 4/10 seriousness — not angry, not intimidating.

shots.title: Mild Surprise / Interest
shots.description: Лёгкое удивление и интерес.
shots.prompt: About 4/10 surprise: eyebrows slightly raised, eyes only slightly more open, lips subtly parted. No exaggerated reaction.

shots.title: Eyes Look Left / Head Frontal
shots.description: Взгляд влево при прямой голове.
shots.prompt: Head stays almost frontal; the eyes move approximately 15–25 degrees toward the subject's LEFT. Natural listening behaviour.

shots.title: Eyes Look Right / Head Frontal
shots.description: Взгляд вправо при прямой голове.
shots.prompt: Head stays almost frontal; the eyes move the same amount in the opposite direction. Only the gaze changes — do not mirror the whole face.

shots.title: Head Slightly Down / Eyes To Camera
shots.description: Голова чуть опущена, взгляд в камеру.
shots.prompt: Head pitches 10–15 degrees downward while the eyes come back up to the camera. No threatening under-brow stare.

shots.title: Head Slightly Up / Eyes To Camera
shots.description: Голова чуть поднята, взгляд в камеру.
shots.prompt: Head pitches 10–15 degrees upward, the eyes compensating naturally back toward the camera. Do not enlarge the nostrils, chin or jaw.

shots.title: Natural Blink
shots.description: Естественное моргание — кадр, который оживляет видео.
shots.prompt: Caught about 80–90 percent through an ordinary blink: both eyes almost closed, with a tiny natural difference in timing between them. Not asleep, not tired, not a wink.
